channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: Ukraine liberates 300 square km in southern counteroffensive, Zelensky says — here's what that means
item.description: "I won't go into too many details, but today I can congratulate our army first and foremost —all the defense forces — because as of today, 300 (square) kilometers have been liberated," Zelensky told Agence France-Presse.

item.title: Ukraine confirms Flamingo strike on key Russian ballistic missile factory
item.description: The Votkinsk Plant is a strategic, state-owned defense enterprise and one of the most important missile factories in Russia. It produces Iskander ballistic missiles — used in attacks against Ukraine — and nuclear-armed intercontinental ballistic missiles.

item.title: Ukraine hits Russian planes, ships in Crimea, artillery in major strikes on occupied territories
item.description: The final extent of the damage on the Crimean Peninsula is still being assessed, the General Staff said.

item.title: Europe's green transition is now a matter of energy security
item.description: Europe's approach to energy security long rested on a simple idea: scale equals safety. That assumption is now being tested in Ukraine — and increasingly proven wrong.For decades, coal-fired power plants have been the backbone of Europe's energy system, underpinning industrial growth, modern living standards,

item.title: Zelensky introduces new sanctions on Russian shadow fleet
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky announced Feb. 21 that Ukraine is imposing new sanctions targeting the captains of Russia's shadow fleet.

item.title: Ukraine condemns Hungarian, Slovak 'ultimatums' amid energy dispute
item.description: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry condemned what it described as "ultimatums and blackmail" from Hungary and Slovakia after the two countries threatened to halt emergency electricity supplies.

item.title: 4 killed in northeastern Ukraine as Russia strikes ambulance carrying minor hospitalized in blast, targets Mondelez factory
item.description: A Russian drone attack in northeastern Ukraine's Sumy Oblast killed two brothers and a married couple, while a missile attack damaged a production facility belonging to U.S. multinational company Mondelez, authorities reported Feb. 21.

item.title: 15 injured, police officer killed as explosions rock western Ukraine's Lviv in terrorist attack
item.description: Explosions as a result of a terrorist attack shook Lviv, injuring 15 and killing a police officer, authorities reported overnight on Feb. 22.

item.title: Ukraine reportedly strikes oil depot in Russian-occupied Luhansk
item.description: Ukraine struck an oil depot in Russian-occupied Luhansk overnight on Feb. 22, Telegram news channel Exilenova+ reported.

item.title: Explosions rock Ukraine's capital as Russia launches ballistic missiles, injuring 2 in Kyiv Oblast
item.description: Several rounds of explosions were reported in Kyiv overnight on Feb. 22, leaving a mother and her child injured as Russia launched ballistic missiles at Ukraine.
